description: This file defines the UserRepository interface for the Book Project, extending Spring Data JPA's JpaRepository to manage User entities. It includes a method to find a User by email.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for managing User entities, extending JpaRepository for CRUD operations and custom query methods.

methods.name: findByEmail
methods.description: Finds a User entity by email address, returning an Optional<User>.
